cold_reset: reopen handle; no OS page-cache eviction
completion_rule: CLI exit zero plus a durable final run_completed event linked to the published result; any failure or missing terminal event disqualifies the run

chunking.description: Non-overlapping exact projected UTF-8 source sections; at most 384 tokens including passage prefix and special tokens; no truncation. Spans address dataset-relative plaintext, not upstream HTML.

import_phase_scope: commit includes commit preparation, old-index prefetch, critical append/durability and Catalog application; checkpoint includes postcommit index preparation, resident construction and suffix persistence/retry; cycles count logical calls, ready cycles count query-usable persistent suffixes after those calls; disjoint diagnostics, not the end-to-end total; omitted when import fails
import_time_scope: continuous first input read through all cold/warm queries and source verification; includes reference generation and journal IO in that interval
journal_durability: flush each event; sync plan and terminal events
latency_scope: continuous search call including preparation, recall, score completion, normalization/fusion and result materialization; excludes reference generation, verification and journal IO; failed samples use frozen search time when a search finished, otherwise started-event elapsed
order: text_bm25,vector_exact,hybrid when available; cold then warm; artifact query order
percentile_method: nearest rank ceil(p*n)-1 for P50/P95, unrounded successful query latencies, separately per mode/cache group; incomplete-group percentiles are diagnostic only
reference: hash-verified raw rows; full-collection streaming BM25 statistics; only the filtered recall union receives supplemental scores before normalization/fusion limits; shared vector metric and fusion primitives; imported IDs only for ties; qrels are quality labels, not a 100-percent-recall assertion
retry_policy: abort on first error; no retries; unexecuted planned samples remain explicit
score_tolerance_rule: absolute error <= tolerance * max(1, abs(expected)); exact ranked external IDs and result count
search_cost_scope: costs are cumulative snapshots per sequence/attempt: use search_completed/search_failed once; completed/failed repeat the same snapshot solely to bind acceptance status and must not be added again; fixed per-search diagnostic counters; failed/reclaimed attempts remain counted; stage times are inclusive diagnostics, not a substitute for or sum defining end-to-end latency; preparation includes optional cache loads across collections; no engine candidate staging reads; source-reference/import/journal IO excluded
search_cost_work_rules: text visits are consumer document/posting visits, not all validator CPU or binary-search comparisons; vector checks count inspected vectors before eligibility and distances count scored components; reuse counts each recalled branch score consumed directly in final candidate construction, including failed fusion attempts; logical bytes count typed payload or index-extent requests, application bytes count successful Read/read_at returns including partial failures, retries and checksum drains; physical disk IO unknown; unset candidate counts are null, never zero
timeout_policy: no internal deadline; externally interrupted journals without a terminal event are incomplete, never successful
warmup_reason: first pass is a measured cold-handle group; the measured warm group repeats it
